description: Crux test: is resize still the cheaper lever now that Muon flattened the epoch curve? Under SGD, resize cost ~0.4 pp/s and epochs ~0.75 pp/s, so resize won. Under Muon, epochs cost ~0.31 pp/s (E027), and resize at 75% cost ~1-1.8 pp/s (E029). The marginal resize rate near 50% under Muon is unmeasured. On tip E028, change only the 24 px fraction, from the first 50% to the first 40% of steps (same antialiased bilinear downsample, schedules tied to step count, both shapes still graphed in build). Report per-seed accuracy.
